findings.summary: The request kernel is not wired into the product composition path. Spec approved.md line 17 ('Replace the product's coordinator/worker round-prompt progression with a durable, serial request-to-Goal-call kernel at the existing composition seam'), line 19 ('DD01 must wire the new request kernel into the product composition path and remove/replace the superseded round/prompt path for the same responsibility'), and the explicit prohibition ('do not build a parallel toy engine whose old path still carries this scope') are unsatisfied. No product source imports request_kernel; only tests/test_goal_request_kernel.py references it. grep across src/ confirms GoalRequestKernel/build_goal_prompt/validate_stop_list appear solely in src/fleet_graph/goal/request_kernel.py. build_line still constructs AgentRunCoordinator + AgentSessionWorker and returns build_goal_line_graph unchanged (graphs/runner.py:208-309), so the old coordinator/worker round-prompt path fully carries the goal-facing responsibility this DD was scoped to replace.

The implementer unilaterally re-scoped the slice: the module docstring (request_kernel.py:49-53) declares 'the removal of the legacy round-prompt line' as a 'follow-up slice', but approved.md's 'Deferred verification and later slices' list (lines 65-69) does not defer the coordination/prompt removal — only 'complete linear Impl->acceptance->CR->FR->Goal->merge workflow replacement', runtime recovery/cancellation, per-repo merges, finalization, full Session pagination and the L1 clerk. Wiring the kernel and removing the round/prompt progression are core DD01 construction (source code), not a forbidden runtime/E2E stage, so deferring them is not a development-stage limitation.
